_readme: Notion export: the `Demo`-checked rows of the four Customization databases.
Committed on purpose — `import-notion-customization-demo.mjs` reads this file, never Notion,
so the import is re-runnable by anyone with a Sanity token and no Notion access.
Regenerate by re-exporting the same columns from Notion; do not hand-edit copy here.
Only the columns the import actually consumes are present. Every image, Short Name,
SEO Page Title, FAQ and Color Range column was empty on all 113 rows and is omitted.
`Description` and `What is` are omitted deliberately: `What is` is a page heading, and
`Description` has no field on customizationOption (its designed home is glossaryTerm).

rows.title: High-Impact Polystyrene (HIPS) Blister Plastic
rows.whyUse: Why Choose HIPS Plastic for Packaging Inserts?
rows.benefits:
A cost-effective choice for durable, rigid, and opaque trays.

Good impact strength and is less brittle than standard PS.

Very easy to thermoform, capturing fine details.

Popular material for cosmetic kits, electronic, and medical trays.
rows.metaDescription: Use HIPS plastic for custom packaging inserts. A low-cost, rigid, and durable opaque tray that offers reliable impact protection for your products.

rows.title: Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET) Blister Plastic
rows.whyUse: Why Choose PET for Plastic Inserts?
rows.benefits:
Exceptional clarity and a glass-like appearance.

Demonstrate excellent strength and shatter resistance.

Food-safe material with good barrier properties.

Widely recyclable, supporting sustainability goals.
rows.metaDescription: Learn why PET is the most popular choice for clear thermoformed trays. Offering glass-like clarity with excellent strength and food-safe properties.

rows.title: Polypropylene (PP) Blister Plastic
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Polypropylene (PP) for Plastic Trays or Inserts?
rows.benefits:
Excellent heat resistance with a high melting point.

High chemical resistance and excellent moisture barrier.

Very durable, tough, and resistant to cracking or shattering.

Best for microwaveable or hot-fill food trays and medical sterilization.
rows.metaDescription: Polypropylene (PP) is a durable, semi-rigid plastic with a high melting point and chemical resistance. Ideal for microwave meals or hot-fill food trays.

rows.title: Black Chipboard (Pure Black Core)
rows.whyUse: Why Use Pure Black Core Chipboard for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Solid black core eliminates any visible grey edges.

Create the ultimate seamless, premium, all-black aesthetic.

Provide a dramatic, high-contrast look when combined with speical finishes.

Ideal for high-end electronics, premium spirits, or luxury gift boxes.
rows.metaDescription: Use pure black bore bhipboard for custom rigid boxes and inserts to get a premium, seamless, all-black look with solid black edges.

rows.title: Standard Chipboard
rows.whyUse: Why Use Standard Chipboard for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Achieve the essential stiffness and sturdy structure for rigid boxes.

Made from 100% recycled materials, aligning with sustainability goals.

Perfect base for laminating or wrapping with custom-printed paper or fabric.

Also used for economical, uncoated rigid inserts or dividers where durability precedes.
rows.metaDescription: Standard chipboard (grey board) is the structural core of rigid boxes. Made from recycled fiber, it provides sturdiness and support beneath the outer wrap.

rows.title: White-Lined Chipboard
rows.whyUse: Why Use White-Lined Chipboard for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Provide a clean, bright white interior finish for rigid boxes.

Eliminate the cost and labor of applying a separate interior paper liner.

Offer a brighter, cleaner appearance than a standard grey interior.

A cost-effective way to achieve a premium look and enhance unboxing.
rows.metaDescription: Use white-lined chipboard for custom rigid boxes to get a clean, white interior finish without the need for a separate white paper liner.

rows.title: Kraft Corrugated Board
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Standard Kraft Corrugated Board for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Excellent strength, durability, and cushioning for product protection.

A cost-effective and standard option for protective packaging.

With a natural brown color to offer a sustainable and rustic appeal

A highly versatile material for boxes, structural inserts, and retail displays.
rows.metaDescription: Kraft corrugated board is the standard material for shipping boxes and cardboard cartons. Eco-friendly, durable, and low-cost for packaging and displays.

rows.title: Litho-Laminated Corrugated Board
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Litho-Laminated Corrugated Board for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Delivers sharp, high-resolution graphics with vibrant and accurate colors.

Offset printing captures fine details, gradients, and complex artwork.

Coated art paper surface supports gloss, matte, and other finishing options.

Combines premium presentation with the strength of corrugated construction.

rows.title: White Lined Corrugated Board
rows.whyUse: Why Choose White Lined Corrugated Board for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Smooth white surface supports clear, high-quality printing.

Cost-effective alternative to fully bleached white corrugated board.

Durable corrugated construction provides reliable product protection.

Ideal for shipping boxes with clean branding and simple graphics.
rows.metaDescription: White-lined corrugated board provides a clean, bright white surface. Ideal for high-quality, vibrant color printing on cardboard boxes and displays.

rows.title: Coated Art Paper Wrap
rows.whyUse: Why Use Coated Art Paper Wrap for Rigid Boxes?
rows.benefits:
Delivers sharp, vibrant printing with excellent color accuracy and detail.

Smooth coated surface provides a refined and premium appearance.

Compatible with various finishes, including gloss, matte, and soft touch.

Versatile option for a wide range of rigid box styles and applications.

rows.title: Metallic Paper Wrap
rows.whyUse: Why Use Metallic Wrap for Rigid Boxes?
rows.benefits:
Creates a reflective, high-shine finish in shades such as gold, silver, copper, and rose gold.

Instantly conveys a high-end, premium, and modern aesthetic.

Creates a bold visual effect that helps packaging stand out on the retail shelf.

Provides a distinctive specialty surface for luxury and statement packaging.
rows.metaDescription: Metallic wrap is a premium paper laminated with a metalized film or foil, creating a bright, reflective, mirror-like finish for rigid boxes.

rows.title: Natural Brown Kraft Paper Wrap
rows.whyUse: Why Use Natural Brown Kraft Paper Wrap for Rigid Boxes?
rows.benefits:
Provide a natural, rustic, and eco-friendly aesthetic.

The uncoated surface delivers a raw, tactile texture.

Offer high strength and tear resistance for a durable wrap.

A cost-effective and recyclable wrapping material.
rows.metaDescription: Use natural brown kraft wrap for custom rigid boxes and inserts to get a strong, durable, and tear-resistant cover with a rustic, eco-friendly aesthetic.

rows.title: Textured & Patterned Paper Wrap
rows.whyUse: Why Use Textured & Patterned Wrap for Rigid Boxes?
rows.benefits:
Creates a tactile experience that enhances customer engagement.

Adds visual depth and premium appeal without relying on printed graphics.

Supports luxury branding with sophisticated textures and patterns.

Helps conceal minor scuffs, fingerprints, and surface imperfections.
rows.metaDescription: Textured paper wraps add a premium, tactile feel to custom rigid boxes, creating a sensory experience that encourages touch and conveys luxury.

rows.title: Uncoated Artboard Paper Wrap
rows.whyUse: Why Use Uncoated Artboard Paper Wrap for Rigid Boxes?
rows.benefits:
Provide a premium, tactile, and non-reflective matte finish.

Create a sophisticated, minimalist, and understated aesthetic.

Resists fingerprints and glare better than gloss-coated papers.

An excellent surface for hot foil stamping, embossing, and debossing.
rows.metaDescription: Uncoated artboard wrap gives rigid boxes a premium, tactile, non-reflective matte finish. Perfect for an understated, minimalist and elegant aesthetic.

rows.title: Cotton
rows.whyUse: Why Use Cotton for Fabric Pouches and Bags?
rows.benefits:
A soft, breathable, and lightweight fabric made of natural fiber.

Highly sustainable material with excellent reusability and recyclability.

Cost-effective for versatile, all-purpose pouch applications.

Washable and gets softer with use.
rows.metaDescription: Cotton fabric is a soft, breathable, and cost-effective, making it a top eco-friendly choice for packaging like reusable pouches and dust bags.

rows.title: Flock Fabric
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Flock Fabric for Pouches and Bags?
rows.benefits:
Dense, plush, and velvet-like texture for enhanced tactile appeal.

Non-abrasive surface protects delicate items from scratches.

Offer a more structured and protective layer than a simple cloth.

Create a premium, high-end look and feel for luxury goods.
rows.metaDescription: Flock fabric offers a soft, non-abrasive, velvet-like texture, ideal for protecting delicate items like jewelry, eyewear, or electronics from scratches.

rows.title: Linen
rows.whyUse: Why Use Linen for Fabric Pouches and Bags?
rows.benefits:
A highly durable and strong natural fiber.

Provide a premium, elegant, and rustic aesthetic with a rough texture.

An eco-friendly and biodegradable material derived from the flax plant.

Linen fabric is naturally breathable and anti-bacterial.
rows.metaDescription: Use linen fabric for eco-friendly and durable fabric pouches and bags. Its unique, rustic texture is perfect for your premium and artisanal goods.

rows.title: Nylon
rows.whyUse: Why Use Nylon for Fabric Pouches and Bags?
rows.benefits:
Excellent durability with high tear and abrasion resistance.

Lightweight and soft while remaining extremely strong.

Provide good water resistance to protect contents from moisture.

With a smooth, premium finish suitable for luxury goods and tech.
rows.metaDescription: Use nylon for fabric pouches and reusable bags. Lightweight yet highly durable, tear-resistant, and water-resistant bags with a smooth, premium finish.

rows.title: Organza
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Organza for Fabric Pouches and Bags?
rows.benefits:
Sheer, translucent quality allows the product inside to be seen.

Provide a delicate, elegant, and shimmering appearance.

A very cost-effective and lightweight option for decorative gift packaging.

Available in a vast range of colors.
rows.metaDescription: Use organza fabric for custom pouches to get a cost-effective, sheer, and elegant see-through bag, perfect for showcasing small gifts or jewelry.

rows.title: Polyester
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Polyester Fabric for Reusable Bags?
rows.benefits:
Cost-effective and durable all-purpose synthetic fabric.

Resists wrinkling, shrinking, and stretching, holding its shape well.

Strong and lightweight with good water and mildew resistance.

Available in many colors for custom branding.
rows.metaDescription: Use polyester fabric for reusable bags to get a durable, low-cost, and versatile material that resists water, wrinkles, and shrinking for lasting use.

rows.title: Satin
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Satin for Fabric Pouches and Bags?
rows.benefits:
Provide a high-gloss, lustrous shine that looks and feels luxurious.

Smooth and soft surface ideal for protecting delicate items.

Instantly communicate top quality and elegance for premium brands.

Drape well and available in a wide range of deep, rich colors.
rows.metaDescription: Discover how the high-shine, smooth, and lustrous surface of satin fabric can create an elegant and luxurious pouch for your premium products.

rows.title: Wool
rows.whyUse: Why Use Wool Fabric or Wool Felt for Pouches and Bags?
rows.benefits:
A durable and naturally elastic fiber for long-lasting use.

Provide excellent natural cushioning and scratch protection.

Offer a premium, soft, and warm tactile feel.

Convey a rustic, organic, and artisanal aesthetic.
rows.metaDescription: Learn how wool fabric, especially wool felt, can be used to create thick, soft, and naturally cushioned pouches perfect for protecting high-end products.

rows.title: Woven Polypropylene (WPP)
rows.whyUse: Why Choose WPP Fabric for Reusable Bags?
rows.benefits:
Provide exceptional strength and tear resistance for carrying bulky items.

The woven structure is highly durable and puncture-resistant.

Often laminated, making it water-resistant and easy to wipe clean.

A cost-effective choice for heavy-duty, long-lasting reusable bags.
rows.metaDescription: Use woven polypropylene (WPP) for reusable bags with excellent strength. Tear-resistant and waterproof woven fabric built to carry heavy items.

rows.title: Ethylene Vinyl Acetate Foam (EVA Foam)
rows.whyUse: Why Use EVA Foam for Box Inserts?
rows.benefits:
Dense, premium foam with a high-end feel and smooth surface.

Offer excellent shock absorption with a firm, supportive structure.

Very durable and non-abrasive, with excellent memory that returns to shape.

Can be die-cut or laser-cut with extreme precision for intricate cavities.
rows.metaDescription: Use EVA foam for premium, high-end packaging box inserts. This dense, closed-cell memory foam offers firm support and can be laser-cut for a perfect fit.

rows.title: Expanded Polyethylene Foam (EPE)
rows.whyUse: Why Use EPE Foam for Box Inserts?
rows.benefits:
Durable, lightweight, and cost-effective foam insert option.

Excellent all-purpose shock absorption for products requiring cushioning.

Soft, non-abrasive surface that prevents scratching delicate finishes.

Closed-cell structure provides resistance to moisture and liquids.
rows.metaDescription: EPE foam is a lightweight, semi-rigid, closed-cell insert, offering excellent shock absorption and a non-abrasive surface to protect delicate items.

rows.title: Polyurethane Foam (PU Foam)
rows.whyUse: Why Use PU Foam for Box Inserts?
rows.benefits:
Excellent shock absorption and vibration dampening.

Soft, sponge-like structure ideal for cushioning delicate, scratch-sensitive items.

Very lightweight to ensure minimal shipping costs.

Can be easily fabricated into custom shapes or egg-crate designs.
rows.metaDescription: Use polyurethane (PU) foam inserts to protect delicate items. This soft and lightweight foam is ideal for shock absorption and vibration dampening.

rows.title: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE)
rows.whyUse: Why Choose HDPE Plastic for Poly Mailer Bags?
rows.benefits:
Stronger and more puncture-resistant compared to LDPE.

Stiff and crinkly to the touch with a milky appearance.

Offer excellent moisture and chemical barrier properties.

A durable and cost-effective option for shipping heavier or sharp items
rows.metaDescription: Use HDPE film for poly mailers with extra strength and durability. This rigid, puncture-resistant plastic is perfect for shipping heavy or sharp goods.

rows.title: Linear Low-Density Polyethylene (LLDPE)
rows.whyUse: Why Choose LLDPE for Poly Mailer Bags?
rows.benefits:
Provide superior puncture and tear resistance.

High strength allows downgauging (using thinner film) while remaining durable.

A high-performance, low-cost choice with excellent flexibility and stretch.

Lightweight and water-resistant for secure shipping.
rows.metaDescription: Use LLDPE for custom poly mailers when durability is key. This tough, flexible film provides superior tear resistance and allows for thinner, lighter bags.

rows.title: Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE)
rows.whyUse: Why Use LDPE for Poly Mailer Bags?
rows.benefits:
Feature a soft, flexible, and stretchy texture.

Provide good puncture and tear resistance due to its flexibility.

Less "crinkly" and noisy than rigid HDPE films.

A low-cost, lightweight, and waterproof material for all-purpose shipping.
rows.metaDescription: LDPE is a soft, flexible, and stretchy plastic film, offering good puncture and tear resistance for all-purpose, lightweight poly mailer bags at low cost.

rows.title: Bamboo Pulp
rows.whyUse: Why Use Bamboo Pulp for Molded Pulp Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Made from bamboo, a highly renewable and fast-growing resource.

Superior strength and durability with long and strong fibers.

Provide greater rigidity and natural water resistance.

A premium and tree-free alternative to wood pulp with a smooth finish.
rows.metaDescription: Bamboo fiber is a strong, highly renewable resource used to create molded pulp inserts that are more durable and water-resistant than wood pulp.

rows.title: Recycled Paper Pulp
rows.whyUse: Why Use Recycled Pulp for Molded Pulp Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Most common and cost-effective material for molded pulp inserts.

Highly eco-friendly by reducing landfill waste.

Create a rustic, natural, and authentic look with a greyish-tan color.

Provide reliable cushioning and bracing for a wide range of products.
rows.metaDescription: Learn how recycled paper (post-consumer waste) is used to create low-cost, eco-friendly molded pulp inserts with a rustic, natural texture.

rows.title: Virgin Pulp (Wood Pulp)
rows.whyUse: Why Use Virgin Pulp for Molded Pulp Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Provides a smooth, refined surface with a natural light cream appearance.

Long, consistent fibers create strong and rigid molded pulp structures.

Can be bleached for a brighter white appearance when desired.

Suitable for premium molded pulp packaging and qualifying food-contact applications.
rows.metaDescription: Virgin pulp (wood pulp) creates strong, rigid molded inserts with a very smooth, clean white finish, often required for FDA food-contact compliance.

rows.title: CCNB (Clay-Coated News Back)
rows.whyUse: Why Choose CCNB Paperboard for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Highly cost-effective and economical paperboard choice.

Made from 100% recycled content, supporting sustainability goals.

Clay-coated white top surface allows high-quality, sharp printing.

Good stiffness and performance for general-purpose packaging.
rows.metaDescription: CCNB paperboard is made from recycled pulp with a coated white top and a grey, uncoated back. A cost-effective material for folding carton packaging.

rows.title: Metallic Board
rows.whyUse: Why Use Metallic Board for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Create a bright, highly reflective, mirror-like metallic base for printing.

Allow for a full spectrum of metallic colors by printing transparent inks on top.

Enable high-contrast designs with opaque ink as a knockout base.

Provide a high-impact, premium look that is more integrated than metallic ink.
rows.metaDescription: Learn how metalized paperboard is created to achieve a vibrant, reflective, full-color metallic look for high-imapct folding cartons.

rows.title: Natural Brown Kraft
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Natural Brown Kraft for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Made from eco-friendly, biodegradable virgin fiber.

Excellent strength, stiffness, moisture, and tear resistance.

Natural kraft color offers a rustic, organic aesthetic.

Uncoated surfaces encourage tactile engagement.
rows.metaDescription: Natural kraft paper is a virgin paperboard with uncoated surfaces, offering rustic, eco-friendly charm with high durability for folding cartons.

rows.title: SBS (Solid Bleached Sulfate)
rows.whyUse: Why Choose SBS for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Premium bleached paperboard with bright white surface for high-impact graphics.

Solid white core avoids dark or grey edges.

Ideal for printing sharp and high-resolution images, easy to score and fold.

Without odor or taste, suitable for food and pharmaceutical products.
rows.metaDescription: Choose SBS paperboard in C1S/C2S for custom folding cartons. A premium, solid white material that provides a superior, clean surface for sharp printing.

rows.title: Textured & Patterned Specialty Board
rows.whyUse: Why Use Textured Paperboard for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Create a tactile and sensory experience that encourages touch.

Add a sophisticated visual element without relying on printed graphics.

Convey a high-end, luxury, or nature-inspired aesthetic.

Textured surface effectively hides minor scuffs or fingerprints.
rows.metaDescription: Discover how textured paperboards with special patterns like linen or leather can add a sophisticated, tactile dimension to folding cartons.

rows.title: White Kraft
rows.whyUse: Why Choose White Kraft for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Provides a clean white appearance throughout the board, including cut edges.

Strong and durable construction supports demanding packaging applications.

Uncoated surface creates a natural, understated, and tactile aesthetic.

Made from bleached virgin kraft fiber for a clean and consistent material.
rows.metaDescription: White Kraft paper provides the superior strength of kraft and the premium, clean look of a solid white paperboard. Perfect for high-end folding cartons.

rows.title: Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene (BOPP) Sticker Film
rows.whyUse: Why Use BOPP Film for Stickers and Labels?
rows.benefits:
Most cost-effective and versatile all-purpose label film.

Excellent clarity and gloss finish offer a premium "no-label" look.

Provide excellent durability, tear, moisture, and chemical resistance.

Best for prime product labels on food, beverage, and cosmetic items.
rows.metaDescription: Need a durable, all-purpose label or sticker? BOPP is the most cost-effective industry standard, offering superior tear and water resistance.

rows.title: Polyester (PET) Sticker Film
rows.whyUse: Why Use PET Film for Stickers and Labels?
rows.benefits:
Offer superior durability, strength, and rigidity for long-lasting use.

Excellent heat and chemical resistance compared to PP labels.

Dimensionally stable and will not shrink or stretch.

Provide exceptional clarity for a premium look on luxury goods.
rows.metaDescription: Use Polyester (PET) film for durable, long-life labels. This rigid, heat-resistant film is perfect for tags on electronics, appliances, and premium goods.

rows.title: Vinyl (PVC) Sticker Film
rows.whyUse: Why Use Vinyl Film for Stickers and Labels?
rows.benefits:
Excellent outdoor durability with superior UV, water, and weather resistance.

Highly durable, flexible, and resistant to scuffs and abrasion.

Highly conformable and adhere well to various surfaces.

Best for outdoor decals, bumper stickers, and all-weather labels.
rows.metaDescription: Discover why Vinyl (PVC) film is the top choice for outdoor decals and labels, providing a tough, waterproof, and UV-resistant label that won't fade.

rows.title: Tinplate
rows.whyUse: Why Use Tinplate for Tin Containers?
rows.benefits:
Provide excellent durability and rigidity with a strong steel core.

Tin coating offers superior corrosion and rust resistance.

Create a strong barrier against light, moisture, and oxygen.

Provide a premium, metallic surface that supports high-quality printing.
rows.metaDescription: Tinplate is a tin-coated steel material, offering a strong, durable, and corrosion-resistant solution for creating high-end, premium tin containers.

rows.title: Blind Debossing
rows.whyUse: Why Use Blind Debossing on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Create a clean, subtle recessed impression without ink or foil.

Emphasize elements like brand names and logos with a minimalist aesthetic.

Add an elegant tactile quality with depth that encourages interactions.

A refined and understated way to achieve premium branding.
rows.metaDescription: Blind debossing creates a recessed image on packaging using only pressure, without ink or foil. A subtle, sophisticated effect to achieve premium branding.

rows.title: Blind Embossing
rows.whyUse: Why Use Blind Embossing on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Create clean, subtle raised designs without ink or foil.

Highlight elements like brand names and logos with a minimalist aesthetic.

Add elegant, sophisticated tactile details that encourage interactions.

A refined and understated way to achieve premium branding.
rows.metaDescription: Use blind embossing to create 3D raised patterns, text, or logos on your packaging. Enhance tactile appeal and premium branding with subtle elegance.

rows.title: Registered Debossing
rows.whyUse: Why is Precise Registration Important for Debossing?
rows.benefits:
Ensures the debossed area perfectly aligns with the printing or foil.

Creates a crisp, clean look reflecting a brand's attention to detail.

Adds depth and emphasis to specific elements like brand name and logo.

Enhances professional brand image and packaging appeal.
rows.metaDescription: Registered debossing precisely aligns indented impression with printing or foil, adding clean, professional depth to specific design elements like logos.

rows.title: Registered Embossing
rows.whyUse: Why is Precise Registration Important for Embossing?
rows.benefits:
Ensures the embossed area perfectly aligns with the printing or foil.

Creates a crisp, clean look reflecting a brand's attention to detail.

Adds emphasis to specific printed elements like brand name and logo with a raised effect.

Enhances professional brand image and packaging appeal.
rows.metaDescription: Registered embossing precisely aligns a raised impression with printing or foil, adding a crisp, high-impact effect to specific design elements like logos.

rows.title: Textured Embossing & Debossing
rows.whyUse: Why Use Textured Embossing on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Combine raised designs with intricate patterns and textures.

Add unique tactile and visual complexity to encourage interactions.

Simulate special materials like leather or woodgrain to enhance perceived value.

Creates a sophisticated, premium feel that elevates brand image.
rows.metaDescription: Discover how textured embossing uses patterned dies to create raised areas with a unique tactile finish. Elevating packaging luxury and brand image.

rows.title: Cold Foiling
rows.whyUse: Why Use Cold Foiling on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Achieve through inline cold foil printing, saving production steps.

Allows for fine details, gradients, and halftones in the foil design.

Cold foil can be overprinted, varnished, or laminated for protection or unique color effects.

A cost-effective and time-efficient foiling method without costly metal dies.
rows.metaDescription: Cold foiling applies metallic, holographic, or colored foil using UV-cured adhesive, allowing fine details, gradients, and overprinting on packaging.

rows.title: Edge Foiling/Gilt Edging
rows.whyUse: Why Use Edge Foiling on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Add a striking metallic or holographic accent to the edges.

Highlight the thickness and quality of the substrate used.

Create a premium, luxurious look to justify higher price points.

Durable details that are resistant to scuffs and fading, for a long-lasting impact.
rows.metaDescription: Edge foiling or gliding applies metallic details to the thick edges of rigid boxes or cartons. Highlight premium quality with a luxurious, shiny accent.

rows.title: Hot Foil Stamping
rows.whyUse: Why Use Hot Foil Stamping on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Create bright, opaque metallic, holographic, or pigmented details.

Highlight brand logos, text, and artwork with eye-catching accents.

Enhance the luxury, perceived quality, and value of your products.

Works well on a wide range of paper materials and some fabric surfaces.
rows.metaDescription: Want shiny, metallic details? Hot foil stamping offers a classic, high-impact way to add gold, silver, or colored foils to your packaging design or logo.

rows.title: Paper Lamination
rows.whyUse: Why Laminate Paper onto Foam or Plastic Inserts?
rows.benefits:
Provide a printable surface directly on the insert for branding or info.

Conceal the raw foam or plastic material for enhanced aesthetics.

Allows for custom colors, textures, or finishes on the insert.

Creates a more premium and finished appearance inside the box.
rows.metaDescription: Paper lamination applies a custom paper sheet onto foam or plastic inserts, providing a printable surface and a premium, refined look inside the box.

rows.title: Spot Glitter
rows.whyUse: Why Add Spot Glitter to Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Create a high-impact, dazzling sparkle effect on targeted areas.

Add a noticeable, gritty texture that enhances sensory appeal.

Add a celebratory or lively feel to attract consumers.

Available in a wide variety of glitter colors, sizes, and densities.
rows.metaDescription: Apply spot glitter to your packaging for targeted, high-impact sparkle. Highlight key areas on boxes or bags with a textured, eye-catching finish.

rows.title: Spot UV / Spot Gloss
rows.whyUse: Why Add Spot UV to Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Create a striking high-gloss contrast against matte lamination or uncoated surfaces.

Highlight and draw attention to key design elements like logos and brand names.

Add a subtle, premium tactile dimension that encourages touch.

Enhance perceived value and sophistication for premium products.
rows.metaDescription: Use Spot UV coating to add high-gloss details to your packaging, making logos and texts pop with a premium, tactile finish on matte surfaces.

rows.title: Flocking
rows.whyUse: Why Add Flocking to Your Packaging Inserts?
rows.benefits:
Create a plush, velvet-like texture for a rich and tactile unboxing experience.

Provide a non-abrasive surface for protecting delicate items from scratches.

Enhance the perceived value and luxury of the products and the brand.

Can be applied precisely to complex shapes and cavities.
rows.metaDescription: Add flocking on custom plastic trays or foam inserts for a premium soft, velvet-like finish that protects your jewelry, cosmetics, or fragile products in style.

rows.title: Metallic Ink
rows.whyUse: Why Use Metallic Ink on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Creates a striking, shiny, metallic luster that catches the eye.

Immediately signals luxury, premium quality, and high value.

Available in various shades like gold, silver, bronze, copper, and more.
rows.metaDescription: Use metallic ink on your custom packaging for a shiny, reflective finish. Real metal flakes create a luxury look that instantly grabs attention.

rows.title: Solvent-Based Ink
rows.whyUse: Why Use Solvent-Based Ink for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Excellent adhesion on non-porous materials like plastics and metals.

Achieve vibrant colors and crisp printing.

Highly durable and weather-resistant for heavy-duty use.

Fast drying and facilitates high-volume printing.
rows.metaDescription: Use solvent-based ink for fast, durable printing on plastic pouches, poly mailers, labels, and metal tins where strong adhesion is essential.

rows.title: Soy-Based Ink
rows.whyUse: Why Use Soy-Based Ink on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Derived from renewable and biodegradable resources.

Achieve sharp printing and vibrant colors.

Safer option for food contact packaging.

Easy to remove during the paper recycling process.

Enhance a brand's sustainable and eco-friendly image.
rows.metaDescription: Choose soy-based ink for eco-friendly printing on boxes and bags. Get vibrant colors, low VOC emissions, and better recyclability than oil-based inks.

rows.title: Thermochromic Ink
rows.whyUse: Why Use Thermochromic Ink on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Creates an interactive effect through color change, like revealing hidden messages.

Adds a unique novelty factor that highly engages consumers.

Indicates if the product is properly stored or safe to consume.

Serves as a potential anti-counterfeiting or tamper-evident feature.
rows.metaDescription: Find out how thermochromic ink adds a surprising, temperature-activated color change effect to custom boxes or labels for interactive engagement.

rows.title: UV Ink
rows.whyUse: Why Use UV Ink on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Delivers sharp details and vibrant colors with excellent durability.

Excellent adhesion to a wide range of porous and non-porous materials.

Instant drying and curing that allows for efficient production

VOC-free printing and curing process make it an eco-friendly ink.
rows.metaDescription: Discover how UV ink allows for fast curing, high durability, and versatile printing on almost any packaging material, from paper to plastic and metal.

rows.title: Water-Based Ink
rows.whyUse: Why Use Water-Based Ink on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Eco-friendly ink with low VOC emissions and reduced odor.

Good adhesion and print quality on porous surfaces like paper.

A non-toxic, safe option for food packaging and children's products.

Contributes to a positive, sustainable brand image.
rows.metaDescription: Water-based ink is a safe, low-VOC, and eco-friendly option for printing on packaging, ideal for food products and sustainable brands.

rows.title: Digital Printing
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Digital Printing for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Extremely cost-effective for short print runs due to minimal setup effort.

Provides fast turnaround times for prototypes, samples, and time-sensitive projects.

Allows for Variable Data Printing (VDP), enabling complex personalization and serialization.

Eco-friendly with less waste, lower emissions, and fewer chemicals used.
rows.metaDescription: Use digital printing for short runs or highly personalized packaging. Benefit from no plate costs, fast turnarounds, and variable data on your packaging.

rows.title: Flexographic Printing
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Flexographic Printing for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Highly efficient and cost-effective for medium to long print runs and large volumes.

Prints well on diverse materials, including uneven and absorbent corrugated board.

Compatible with various ink types, such as eco-friendly water-based options.

Suitable for solid colors, line work, and basic graphics.
rows.metaDescription: Use flexographic printing for high-volume corrugated box and folding carton production. Benefit from high speeds and cost savings on larger runs.

rows.title: Gravure Printing (Rotogravure)
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Gravure Printing for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Durable, engraved cylinders allow for millions of impressions without degradation.

Delivers outstanding print quality and rich color densities at high speed.

Achieves consistent results over extremely long runs.

Ideal for mass production of flexible films, pouches, and labels.
rows.metaDescription: Gravure printing offers unmatched quality and speed for commercial high-volume packaging like flexible pouches, film labels, premium cartons, and liners.

rows.title: Offset Printing (Lithography)
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Offset Printing for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Produces exceptionally high-quality images with sharp details and text.

Excellent color consistency and cost-effective for medium to large volume production.

Versatile printing on paper, paperboard, and liners for lamination.

Wide range of ink and coating options available for visual enhancement.
rows.metaDescription: Offset printing delivers superior image quality with sharp details and color consistency for paper, rigid box wraps, labels, bags, and corrugated displays.

rows.title: Screen Printing (Silkscreen)
rows.whyUse: Why Choose Screen Printing for Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Achieve excellent ink opacity and vibrant colors, ensuring visibility even on dark surfaces.

Ideal for applying thick layers, such as high-build spot UV or tactile effects on logos and labels.

Durable print results that are resistant to fading and scratching.

Suitable for a wide variety of packaging materials.
rows.metaDescription: Silk screen printing offers excellent ink opacity and vibrancy. Perfect for bold graphics on boxes, bags, and displays, or for applying special effects.

rows.title: Child Resistant Closures (Rigid Boxes)
rows.whyUse: Why Use Child Resistant Closures for Rigid Boxes?
rows.benefits:
Meets strict legal requirements for regulated industries.

Prevents accidental access by children, ensuring product safety.

Builds brand credibility by showing a commitment to consumer safety.

Provides a secure closure that enhances the product's premium feel.
rows.metaDescription: Child-resistant closures for rigid boxes provide certified safety, ensuring your products meet legal standards for regulated markets like cannabis.

rows.title: Magnetic Closure
rows.whyUse: Why Use Magnetic Closures on Your Rigid Boxes?
rows.benefits:
Creates a clean, seamless appearance with no external hardware.

Provides a user-friendly closure that is easy to open and reseal.

Delivers a premium unboxing experience with an audible "snap."

Keeps the box securely closed during handling.
rows.metaDescription: Create a premium feel with magnetic closures for custom rigid boxes. Learn how this seamless feature can elevate your brand's unboxing experience.

rows.title: Velcro
rows.whyUse: Why Use a Velcro Closure for Your Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Provides a strong, secure hold that is reliable for repeated use.

Offers a unique and satisfying sound and feel during unboxing.

Adds a functional, resealable closure to your custom boxes and bags.

Cost-effective alternative to magnetic closures or zippers.
rows.metaDescription: Use Velcro closures for a secure, resealable feature on reusable bags and rigid boxes. Explore unique closure options to make your packaging stand out.

rows.title: Embedded LED Lighting
rows.whyUse: Why Add Embedded LED Lighting to Your Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Generates an impactful "reveal" moment the instant the box is opened.

Spotlights the product, making it the clear center of attention.

Directly signals a premium product and significant value.
rows.metaDescription: Discover how sensor-activated LED lighting built into a rigid box creates a stunning, illuminated reveal for your high-value luxury products.

rows.title: Metal Plaque
rows.whyUse: Why Use Metal Plaques on Rigid Boxes?
rows.benefits:
Adds a tangible sense of weight and premium quality to the box.

Creates a durable, high-end branding element that stands out.

Signals a message of luxury, heritage, and craftsmanship.

Available in various materials and metallic sheen to match your branding.
rows.metaDescription: See how a custom-engraved metal plaque can be added to your rigid boxes to communicate a strong, lasting message of heritage and luxury.

rows.title: Mirror
rows.whyUse: Why Add a Mirror to Your Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Adds practical, on-the-go functionality for beauty and jewelry products.

Increases the perceived value and luxury of your brand.

Creates a bright and engaging presentation when the box is opened.

Encourages long-term use of the box as a reusable keepsake.
rows.metaDescription: A custom mirror inside a rigid box adds on-the-go functionality and a bright, premium feel for beauty products, turning the package into a keepsake.

rows.title: Diecut Handle
rows.whyUse: Why Choose a Diecut Handle for Shopping Bags?
rows.benefits:
Creates a clean, minimalist, and modern look for your bags.

A cost-effective option that requires no additional materials.

Provides a comfortable grip when properly reinforced.

Die-cut into unique shapes and stand out from standard bags.
rows.metaDescription: A diecut handle gives paper shopping bags a clean, modern look by integrating the handle directly into the bag's design for a minimalist aesthetic.

rows.title: Grosgrain Ribbon Handle
rows.whyUse: Why Choose a Grosgrain Ribbon Handle?
rows.benefits:
The ribbed texture provides a classic, professional appearance.

More durable and robust than smoother satin ribbon options.

The coarse surface offers an understated and sophisticated look.

Available in a wide variety of colors to match your branding.
rows.metaDescription: The distinct ribbed texture of a grosgrain ribbon handle offers a durable, sophisticated, and professional handle option for luxury packaging.

rows.title: Metal Handle
rows.whyUse: Why Add a Metal Handle to Your Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Offers maximum durability and a very secure carrying grip.

Adds a unique vintage, industrial, or high-end mechanical look.

Greatly increases the perceived value and keepsake quality of the box.

A robust handle option for heavy-duty packaging needs.
rows.metaDescription: Metal handles for rigid and tin boxes provide exceptional strength and a distinct vintage look, turning your package into a durable keepsake case.

rows.title: Twisted Paper Handle
rows.whyUse: Why Choose a Twisted Paper Handle for Shopping Bags?
rows.benefits:
More durable and stronger than standard flat paper handles.

The twisted cord is comfortable to hold, even with heavier items.

Provides a premium and professional look for custom paper bags.

An eco-friendly, fully recyclable handle option for sustainable brands.
rows.metaDescription: Learn why the strong, cord-like construction of a twisted paper handle makes it the popular choice for durable and professional retail bags.

rows.title: Ribbon Lift
rows.whyUse: Why Use a Ribbon Lift in Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Allows for the easy and safe removal of tightly fitted products.

Prevents damage to the contents that can occur from prying them out.

Adds a user-friendly, elegant, and thoughtful detail to the design.

Creates a more luxurious and interactive unboxing experience.
rows.metaDescription: Learn how a simple ribbon lift glued to the bottom of a rigid box provides an elegant solution for safely lifting out tightly fitted contents.

rows.title: Ribbon Pull
rows.whyUse: Why Use a Ribbon Pull on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Provides a functional grip to lift open a hinged lid with minimal effort.

Adds a subtle, elegant, and user-friendly detail to the design.

A cost-effective way to improve the unboxing experience.

Fully customizable with different ribbon materials, colors, and widths.
rows.metaDescription: A ribbon pull is a small, elegant tab added to the edge of a hinged lid on a custom box, making it much easier to lift open with a simple pull.

rows.title: Ribbon Pull Tab
rows.whyUse: Why Use Ribbon Pull Tabs on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Functions as an elegant and effective handle for pulling drawer boxes.

Adds a soft, premium touch to the unboxing interaction.

Offers a wide range of color options to align with your branding.

A classic and cost-effective solution for improving usability.
rows.metaDescription: A ribbon pull tab adds a classic, functional loop to drawer-style boxes and cartons, making them easy to pull open with an elegant, cost-effective touch.

rows.title: Metal Corner Protectors
rows.whyUse: Why Use Metal Corner Protectors on Rigid Boxes?
rows.benefits:
Protects corners from bumps, dents, and everyday wear.

Greatly enhances the durability and lifespan of the box.

Adds a premium, vintage, or industrial design element.

Increases the perceived value and keepsake quality of the packaging.
rows.metaDescription: Decorative metal corner protectors safeguard rigid boxes from dents and damage. Add a touch of premium, vintage style while ensuring lasting durability.

rows.title: Paper Wallet
rows.whyUse: Why Add a Paper Wallet to Your Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Functions as a dedicated "pouch" to securely hold booklets or manuals.

Consolidates multiple documents and cards into one organized spot.

Delivers a professional and impressive presentation for kits.

Can be fully branded to act as a standalone marketing piece.
rows.metaDescription: Organize documents with a custom paper wallet for packaging boxes. Neatly hold booklets, cards, user manuals, or marketing materials.

rows.title: Diecut Window
rows.whyUse: Why Use a Diecut Window on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Allows customers to directly see and touch the product inside.

Creates unique storytelling with custom-shaped cut-outs.

Showcases product materials, colors, or textures effectively.

A plastic-free window option for eco-friendly packaging goals.
rows.metaDescription: Create a custom diecut window to let customers see and touch your product. Explore shaped cut-outs to make your packaging interactive and unique.

rows.title: Window Patching
rows.whyUse: Why Use Window Patching on Packaging?
rows.benefits:
Allows customers to see the product without opening the package.

Protects contents from dust, dirt, and damage during handling.

Builds consumer trust by showing the actual product's color and quality.

Creates a premium, retail-ready presentation that can boost sales.
rows.metaDescription: Add a clear window patch to your packaging to showcase the product inside, build customer trust, and maintain a high-end, protective presentation.
